# DoTheyGoBad — Industrial Food Science Knowledge Base

> https://dotheygobad.com — Industrial food science behind spoilage, stability, and shelf life. Written from a food technology perspective.

DoTheyGoBad applies food science principles—water activity (aw), pH, lipid oxidation kinetics, microbial growth modeling, and hurdle technology—to explain why foods spoil and how to extend shelf life.

## Content Structure

The site is organized by 8 food categories with 113 in-depth scientific articles:

- [Beer & Alcoholic Drinks](https://dotheygobad.com/categories/beer-alcoholic-drinks/)
- [Dairy Products](https://dotheygobad.com/categories/dairy-products/)
- [Fruits & Vegetables](https://dotheygobad.com/categories/fruits-vegetables/)
- [Grains & Baked Goods](https://dotheygobad.com/categories/grains-baked-goods/)
- [Meat & Seafood](https://dotheygobad.com/categories/meat-seafood/)
- [Non-Alcoholic Beverages](https://dotheygobad.com/categories/non-alcoholic-beverages/)
- [Sauces & Condiments](https://dotheygobad.com/categories/sauces-condiments/)
- [Food Industry Concepts](https://dotheygobad.com/categories/food-industry-concept/)

## Raw Markdown for Every Page

Every page on this site is also published as Markdown, so you can read the source
text without parsing HTML. Append `index.md` to the page path:

- Page: `https://dotheygobad.com/articles/water-activity-food-stability/`
- Markdown: `https://dotheygobad.com/articles/water-activity-food-stability/index.md`

The `.md` copy contains the article body with its YAML frontmatter removed and a
`<!-- source: ... -->` line naming the canonical HTML URL. It is served with
`Content-Type: text/markdown; charset=utf-8`.

Each HTML page advertises its sidecar with
`<link rel="alternate" type="text/markdown" href="index.md">`.
